title: Storefront types by business category (content/storefronts.json). Unnamed: iconography only.
description: Maps a NAICS code (the pipeline's storefront anchors carry the business registry's self-reported code) to a storefront kit: a sign shape and street props. The longest matching prefix wins (storefrontFor in src/content/storefronts.ts). Signs carry no text and no names: the sign slot is reserved, signText stays null.

noStorefrontPrefixes.description: Codes that never get a kit even though a broader prefix matches (non-store retail, caterers). Mirrors the pipeline's exclusions.

naicsNote.description: Which NAICS vintage each prefix comes from, and why it is here.

signSlot.description: The empty panel reserved for a future sign, in metres, relative to the shopfront.

nightGlow.description: The sign or a prop is lit after dark.

signText.description: Reserved for later. Must be null for now: storefronts are unnamed.

signShape.description: neonPanel: a glowing tube panel in the window, shaped like a beer glass; fasciaBand: a flat blank band above the door; cupBlade: a projecting blade sign shaped like a coffee cup; breadBlade: a projecting loaf-shaped blade; barberPole: the striped spinning pole is the sign; scissorsBlade: a projecting scissors-and-comb blade; projectingCross: a lit cross on a bracket; hangerBlade: a projecting coat-hanger blade; awningValance: the sign is the awning's front flap.

prop.description: Street-level dressing the renderer places at the shopfront. Assets build one generic model per prop.
